fire: And the servant answered, Lord, thou knowest not whence he cometh nor whither he goeth.
Behold, the hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear his voice.
For the Son of man goeth as it is written of him, and woe to that man.
The fool hath said in his heart that no man seeth him, yet the Lord knoweth all.
Thus saith the Lord: he that heareth my word and goeth in my way shall live.
And the shepherd goeth before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets, and whoso cometh shall find.
Therefore the wise man buildeth upon the rock, and when the flood cometh his house standeth.
quiet: And the servant answered, Lord, you do not know where he comes from or where he goes.
Look, the hour is coming, and is already here, when the dead will hear his voice.
For the Son of man goes as it is written of him, and woe to that man.
The fool has said in his heart that no one sees him, yet the Lord knows all.
So says the Lord: whoever hears my word and walks in my way will live.
And the shepherd walks ahead of them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
Wisdom calls out in the street; she raises her voice, and whoever comes will find.
So the wise man builds upon the rock, and when the flood comes his house stands.
